options.name: --silent
options.description:
Suppress console output (a command line that cannot be understood
is still reported on standard error)

options.name: --results
options.description: Write validation results to file (.trx or .xml)

options.name: --depth
options.description: Set heading depth for markdown output (default: 1)

options.name: --config
options.description: Settings file (default: .textlint.yaml in the root directory, if present)

options.name: --root
options.description:
Directory that patterns and the default settings file are relative to
(default: current directory)

options.name: --language
options.description: Language of the dictionaries, e.g. en-US or en-GB (overrides the settings)

options.name: --allow-empty
options.description: Accept patterns that match no files (default: exit code 1)

options.name: --max-parallelism
options.description:
Maximum number of files checked at the same time (default: processor count)
[globs...] are the files to check: paths or glob patterns, relative or absolute, replacing the
'files' setting; the 'ignorePaths' setting still applies. Quote globs so the shell does not
expand them.
Exit codes: 0 = no issues; 1 = issues found, a file could not be checked, no files matched, or an error
occurred.
